scope: BinaryToUnaryControl constructs d literal unary ticks from a marked width-w binary word: exact first halt d*(2w+6)+2w+8, every-prefix cells<=w+d+4; counter consumed to zero.
PairedDifferenceArithmetic derives comparison from actual carry-out, then forward/reverse nonnegative difference from the accepted seven-gate scan identity.

MarkedBitDifference performs the actual carry-in initialization, first pass, branch, optional reverse pass, fresh one-bit magnitude extraction, marker creation, head returns and scratch clear. Exact first halt17w+22 or28w+28; every-prefixcells<=2w+4.
PairedDifferenceUnary joins those concrete traces with one charged finite switch and all three tapes. Time<=d*(2w+6)+30w+37; every-prefixcells<=2w+d+6.
caveats: d is numeric magnitude. Unary output and repeated decrement cost may be exponential in encoded bit width. No linear-in-bitlength claim.

The composed input is a supplied equal-width paired marked exponent word, allowing leading zeros and empty width. Its original word encoding and paired layout are explicit premises of the input representation.
Output work tapes start blank; copied binary counter is consumed to zero. Overwritten scratch and arbitrary old storage are not restored.
Physical allocation/simulation, branch-selected downstream routing/padding and whole selected recursion/uniform cost remain separate.
The unsigned paid-layout successor is excluded from this package.
The explicit kappa is author-checked selected context; these generic implementation lemmas do not by themselves prove the full integer-multiplication exponent theorem.

MarkedBitDifference.difference_result : ∀ (rows : List SequentialBitAddition.Row) (r : SequentialBitAddition.Registers),
  MarkedBitDifference.run (MarkedBitDifference.totalTime rows r) (MarkedBitDifference.initial rows r) =
      MarkedBitDifference.final rows r ∧
    (MarkedBitDifference.final rows r).phase = MarkedBitDifference.Phase.halt ∧
      ∀ k < MarkedBitDifference.totalTime rows r,
        (MarkedBitDifference.run k (MarkedBitDifference.initial rows r)).phase ≠ MarkedBitDifference.Phase.halt
MarkedBitDifference.chosen_value : ∀ (rows : List SequentialBitAddition.Row) (r : SequentialBitAddition.Registers),
  let p := List.map Prod.fst rows;
  let out := List.map Prod.snd (MarkedBitDifference.chosenRows rows r);
  if MarkedBitDifference.chosenReverse rows r = true then
    SequentialBitAddition.decode (SequentialBitAddition.leftBits p) <
        SequentialBitAddition.decode (SequentialBitAddition.rightBits p) ∧
      SequentialBitAddition.decode out =
        SequentialBitAddition.decode (SequentialBitAddition.rightBits p) -
          SequentialBitAddition.decode (SequentialBitAddition.leftBits p)
  else
    SequentialBitAddition.decode (SequentialBitAddition.rightBits p) ≤
        SequentialBitAddition.decode (SequentialBitAddition.leftBits p) ∧
      SequentialBitAddition.decode out =
        SequentialBitAddition.decode (SequentialBitAddition.leftBits p) -
          SequentialBitAddition.decode (SequentialBitAddition.rightBits p)
